rounds.text: Gujarat Raffia Industries Ltd is demonstrating a powerful acceleration in its core business, highlighted by a trailing twelve-month compounded sales growth of 195% [E17] and recent quarterly sales surging by 239% year-on-year [E67]. This top-line momentum is successfully translating into bottom-line expansion, with trailing twelve-month profit growth reaching 102% [E21] and net profit scaling up by 310% year-on-year [E69]. Operational quality is equally robust, evidenced by a cash conversion ratio of 4.67x where operating cash flows of Rs 4.90 Cr fully back reported profits [E34, E35] and represent 162% of operating profit [E37]. Furthermore, the balance sheet is exceptionally lean as the company is almost debt-free [E59] with borrowings reduced to Rs 1.87 Cr [E39] and a low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.08x [E38], while working capital requirements have efficiently compressed from 67.1 days to 42.6 days [E62]. Valuation multiples also present an attractive entry relative to the broader sector, trading at an EV/EBITDA of 5.51x against a sector benchmark of 18.02x [E11], alongside a price-to-book ratio of 0.98x [E2] which sits well below the sector benchmark of 4.69x [E7]. Conceded: [E10], [E12], [E44], [E65].
